Możemy zacząć od jednego zespołu lub pro: We can start with one team or workflow. Spaces have their own statuses, fields and views, so deployment can fit the way each department works.
Czy przeniesiecie dane z Excela i Arkusz: Can you migrate data from Excel and Google Sheets?
Tak. Po analizie plików dopasujemy kolum: Yes. After reviewing the files, we will map columns to app fields and prepare an automated import. Google Sheets data comes from an export. For Excel on SharePoint or OneDrive, two-way synchronization of selected data is also possible. We will agree separately how to handle formulas and unusual spreadsheet layouts.
Czy musimy korzystać z Microsoft 365?: Do we have to use Microsoft 365?
Nie. Zespół może logować się przez Googl: No. Your team can sign in with Google Workspace, Okta, another OpenID Connect provider or password accounts with two-factor authentication managed by the app. User lists can come from Google Directory, Microsoft Graph or SCIM. Microsoft 365 is needed only to turn incoming emails into requests; notifications and reports can use any SMTP server.
Czym różni się demo od pilotażu?: How is the demo different from a pilot?
Demo uruchamiasz samodzielnie, w kilka c: Launch the demo yourself in moments, without signing up. It is a separate copy of the app with fictional data, deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity. A pilot is a free trial deployment for your team, prepared with us using your workflows, data and sign-in setup.
Czy Spinka i własny agent są obowiązkowe: Are Spinka and an AI agent required?
No. You can use the app without AI. An administrator enables Spinka, and you connect your own agent through MCP. You approve its access scope in SprintSpaces; permission to change data must be enabled separately.
Czy mogę połączyć SprintSpaces z innymi: Can I connect SprintSpaces to other tools?
Tak. Poczta Microsoft 365 obsługuje zgło: Yes. Microsoft 365 mail handles requests and replies, and outgoing mail also works through SMTP. The REST API, CSV import and export, and signed webhooks let you build integrations and automations, for example in n8n or Zapier. MCP connects your own AI agent, while SCIM and Google or Microsoft directories supply user lists. For Excel on SharePoint or OneDrive, we can configure synchronization of selected data.
Czy to aplikacja tylko dla programistów?: Is the app only for developers?
Nie. Można w niej prowadzić projekty, ob: No. Use it to manage projects, IT requests, purchase requests and administrative tasks. Statuses, issue types and forms are tailored to how your team works.

Przycisk „Uruchom darmowe demo” wysyła z: The “Launch a free demo” button sends a random request identifier and the selected sign-in profile from your browser to the demo service.
